$comment: Parent-org policies for boop's Turnkey API user (#286). UNVALIDATED: none of these has been submitted to the live Turnkey API. See docs/turnkey-custody.md before applying. Replace <BOOP_API_USER_ID> with the API user's userId. Order does not matter: Turnkey denies by default, and an EFFECT_DENY overrides every allow.

policies.policyName: boop-api-user: allow OTP relay and sub-org creation
policies.notes: The only activities convex/authInternal.ts submits. VERIFY_OTP_V2 only relays a bundle the client encrypted to the enclave; the resulting token is bound to the client's session key.

policies.policyName: boop-api-user: deny parent-chosen-key and plaintext-code auth
policies.notes: Each of these either lets the caller choose the key a credential is encrypted to, or carries a plaintext code, so it could hand boop's backend a session in a user's sub-org.

policies.policyName: boop-api-user: deny credential, key and export changes
policies.notes: Belt and braces: the allow policy already excludes these. Covers both of the author's Turnkey Ed25519 keys (#286 PR b): the author key (m/44'/501'/0'/0', DID updates) and the assertion key (m/44'/501'/1'/0', Originals entries). Neither may be signed with, exported, or added to by boop's API user; the user's own session creates the assertion account when a sub-org lacks it. API keys and passkeys are both the CREDENTIAL resource. The resource names are the least certain part of this file; if Turnkey rejects one, drop that term, not the policy.
